claim_status: conditional_model_result; hypothetical reference T0-HYP-1; not a measurement, not a safety envelope, not validated
provenance_note: material k values are manufacturer nominal references (see config source cards); ranges are assumed sensitivity domains, not distributions; boundaries, loads and comparators are hypothetical study choices; the rear reservoir is an idealization
omitted_effects_delimiting_scope: contacting human body / effusivity / exposure duration
reservoir realization, energy, mass, environmental coupling and capacity cap
interpretation_caveats: The linear constant-property model has no internal validity bound; outputs far above ambient (e.g. rear-blocked 5 W and 10 W settings) lie where omitted radiation and property changes may materially alter the result. The formal steady model rejects the full load; the physical credibility of those large temperature rises has not been established.

Lower T_outer and lower T_H trade against each other on one line for fixed boundaries and loads (T_H = T_res + R_rej*(P_total - h*A*(T_outer - T_amb))); no stack is better in both.  No ranking is implied.

silicone_ref.label: firm reference silicone elastomer (nominal); not selected for biological contact; not a skin-compliance analogue
silicone_ref.density_note: from specific gravity 1.03 at 25 C; used only for modeled-mass reporting
silicone_ref.uncertainty_category: k nominal = manufacturer typical value, test conditions not stated on page; range = assumed sensitivity domain, not a tolerance or distribution

polyimide_film_ref.label: bare nominal polyimide film; traces, components and wiring unmodeled
polyimide_film_ref.cp_note: provenance only; unused in the steady model
polyimide_film_ref.uncertainty_category: k nominal = indexed datasheet value (0.20 at 23 C, ASTM D5470 per index); range = assumed sensitivity domain

contacts.H_to_inner_silicone_attachment: ideal in reference; omitted uncertainty, not folded into r_c

config_echo.stacks_status: computational references; not products, devices, fabrication recipes or selected assemblies; no tactile, barrier or mechanical equivalence implied

thickness_perturbation.applies_to: two silicone layers (common bias or independent per-layer deviations); film held nominal in first study (clarification C4)

boundaries.h_status: assumed convection coefficient; not measured; not derived from a specified airflow
boundaries.rear_reservoir_status: ideal isothermal boundary; energy, mass, environmental coupling and capacity unmodeled; heat demand reported, not guaranteed achievable
boundaries.radiation: omitted in baseline; any extension is a separate case in kelvin
boundaries.offsets_T_amb_T_res: not part of this study; later separate extension only

body.status: comparison values held identical across stacks; not a validated load

sensor.status: idealised uniform sheet at film midplane; zero added thickness/mass; counted once

comparators.label: study_comparator_only
comparators.status: arbitrary study comparators; no standard applied; not safe-contact or component limits

local_source_refs.L3: PF0 report: 144 cases, 6/7 checks, flow_wall_capacity_monotonic=false retained
local_source_refs.L5_L6: KMAP1 contract and intake review; not used here
